plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: Every personal skill in one plugin: how-to-chrome (drive the user's real Chrome via CDP), grill-me (stress-test a plan through questions), daily-journal (time-aware development journaling), obsidian-vault (personal markdown notes folder), nudge (time-based reminders), test-driven-development (Logic Gate + Iron Rule TDD), and i-have-adhd (ADHD-friendly output style).
